question: Can a bounded revision algorithm propagate a structured policy change through an existing instance, propose a narrow patch and preserve unrelated design?
scope: Structured rule -> requirement-mapped prompt adapter -> directed data/lifecycle and upward membership reachability -> proposed patch -> preservation and native-reference validation -> optimistic revision save. No free-text intent understanding, behavioral classification or general compiler claim.
exposure: Same-author exposed cases and assessor. An integration preview probe preceded this protocol; no preregistered or independent evaluation claim.

criteria.reference_match: expected blocked gap or expected affected set plus preserved unrelated content and proposed-only status
criteria.safe_commit: live store accepts only regenerated impact-method plans with matching base and digest; comparison variants never committed
criteria.preservation: old requirements, gaps, links, questions, identities, native refs and nonseed configurations unchanged

limits.predicateGrammar: two explicit boolean fact fields; equals true; urgent/routine result; uncertainty otherwise

hypotheses.H1: impact closure identifies explicit review reachability in authored graphs
hypotheses.H2: selective patches preserve unrelated content better than direct-only or rewrite-all ablations
hypotheses.H3: stale/tampered previews cannot overwrite a current design

claim_boundary: Reachability is a conservative reassessment scope, not semantic proof. A saved proposed rule is not an approved policy. Raw-ticket predicate extraction remains a recorded gap. Local structural tests do not validate Langflow behavior.
artifacts: baseline snapshot, protocol/module hashes, all case outputs and failures, negative corruption checks, Node store tests, Jupyter cell outputs, live UI revision evidence
revision: After first comparison, preservation guard was strengthened for prior decision records and unchanged entity count. Earlier results retained in round-1. Same exposed cases rerun; no independent replication claim.
reproduction: Final harness imports captured implementation modules identical to the live module at capture, with a dedicated pinned Ajv package/lock and temporary store fixtures. This preserves executable research independently of uncommitted application scaffolding. No algorithm change.
